title: %and — boolean AND
purpose: Return true only when both conditions are truthy.
notes: Each operand is itself a verb-expression that yields a boolean (%gte …, %lt …).
Exactly two operands; nest %and inside %and for three or more conditions.

avoid.why: quoted operands are plain strings, and a string is only truthy when it spells "true"/"yes"/"y"/"1"; an arbitrary string like "@.a" is falsy, so this returns ?false regardless of @.a. Pass real boolean verb-expressions, not quoted paths.
